# 1 Clement Chapter 64 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 64 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_064_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 64

*[Closing Doxology]*

**64:1** May the God of all things — who sees everything, who rules all spirits, who is Lord of all flesh, who chose the Lord Jesus Christ and who through him chose us as his own special people — grant to every soul called by his glorious and holy name:

*faith and reverence,*
*peace and patience,*
*self-control and purity*
*and sobriety —*

that they may be found pleasing to his name, through our High Priest and Protector, Jesus Christ. To him be glory and majesty, power and honor, now and forever and ever. Amen.

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
